extraction: Complete sole swift fenced block, with its final newline; no edits or omitted branches
capturePolicy: At most one desktop screenshot per live process, 0.2 seconds after launch, only with preflight permission. No prompt, grant, focus change, retry or lifetime extension. A capture is not proof of rendered fixture content until inspected.
scope: Disposable standalone diagnostic, never merge; no Caper build, linkage or test execution
